It was not possible to connect to the redis server(s). ConnectTimeout, serverEndpoint: redis-cart:6379, timeout: 5000' (40 hits) plus 'dial tcp 10.68.60.91:7070: i/o timeout' (8 hits); cartservice's own error log repeats 58x 'RedisConnectionException ... ConnectTimeout'. Service objects and endpoints are correctly bound (redis-cart 10.68.166.170:6379 -> 172.20.1.173:6379; cartservice -> 172.20.2.200:7070), ruling out selector/port/DNS faults, and redis-cart pod is Running on worker-01. The decisive discriminator is the TCP probe on the Service-declared port: redis-cart:6379 succeeds from worker-01 (open) and worker-03 (open) but fails from worker-02 ('punt! Terminated / Connection Failed'); both failing callers (cartservice, checkoutservice) are scheduled on worker-02 and both target ClusterIPs, while frontend on worker-01 reaches the same VIPs fine. On worker-02 the mechanism is read directly: kube-proxy.service is 'inactive (dead) since Fri 2026-01-02 15:46:13 CST' (code=killed, signal=TERM) while kubelet and containerd are active, the node is Ready with NetworkUnavailable=False (FlannelIsUp), no taints and not cordoned; worker-01's kube-proxy is active for contrast. Namespace events are all Normal apart from FailedCreate serviceaccount warnings whose pods exist and run (setup history). Root cause: kube-proxy unavailable on worker-02 removed that node's Service VIP forwarding, breaking cartservice -> redis-cart and checkoutservice -> cartservice.
